versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00177, SRS_Rte_00245 For NvBlockDescriptor s which need to combine several writing strategies (See [SWS_Rte_04565], [SWS_Rte_04566], [SWS_Rte_04567]), the RunnableEntity of the NvBlockDescriptor shall be activated by one TimingEvent or DataRe- ceivedEvent per writing strategy according to the requirements [SWS_Rte_08087] and [SWS_Rte_08088].
